title: ArrowTracker
description: Plugin just adds arrow that points u to the target location
body:
- Use `/tracker <x> <z>` to set a target point.
  - Use again to turn it off.
- Resourcepack is required:
  - [ArrowTracker.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29009154/ArrowTracker.zip)
- Also make sure that server has PacketEvent
  - https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents
- GitHub & API Documentation:
  - https://github.com/FrustratedQuim/ArrowTracker
